name: React Bits
summary: Open-source library of 170+ animated React components, text animations, backgrounds and micro interactions.
description: Copy-paste React components for creative developers: text animations, animations, UI components, animated backgrounds and micro interactions, each shipped in four implementation variants (JavaScript or TypeScript, CSS or Tailwind). Install by copying source or through the jsrepo or shadcn CLI; dependencies such as gsap, motion, three.js or ogl vary per component. An MCP setup and llms.txt make it agent-friendly; the paid React Bits Pro adds 150 components, 280 blocks, 300 app UI screens and Next.js templates.
contains: 171 free animated components with live demos and source
groups: text animations, animations, components, backgrounds, micro interactions
each component ships in four variants: JS or TS, CSS or Tailwind
installs via shadcn or jsrepo CLI, and a shadcn registry with 684 items
